Name: Harvest Moon Wizard Replacement - 9 (or 12) Portraits Plus Children
Author: sopholophagus
Description:
1.6 note: I have tested, and this mod should be compatible with 1.6 when it releases. Whether or not Romanceable Rasmodius is compatible with 1.6, I am not sure, but the portraits and sprites from this mod should work. Please let me know if there are issues.
----

This is an expansion of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54009827]TheMainFlamingoose[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4060]Harvest Moon Wizard Replacement[/url] to add an addition 7 expressions (an additional 10 for the SVE version). A recent update of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073?tab=description]Romanceable Rasmodius - Narrative Overhauled and Marriageable Wizard[/url] added support for 9 portraits, so this allows the use of the Harvest Moon wizard with the latest update. 

Unlike the original, this mod uses Content Patcher. Additionally, the sprites have been fixed to work correctly with up-to-date Romanceable Rasmodius cutscenes. 

As of version 1.1.0, you'll have the option to turn on wizard babies. This is a recolor of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/32975490]iakora[/url]﻿'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/552]Babies Take After Spouse[/url]﻿ to match the Harvest Moon wizard's coloring. Set "Wizard Babies" to true in the config to use wizard children. There are three skin colors: Lighter, Medium, and Darker. As with Babies Take After Spouse, female toddlers can have pigtails or hairbuns and male toddlers can have messy or combed hair.

Downloads.Description: Compatibility fixes. Includes the sprite, portrait sheet, and wizard children
